- [ ] No private Discord tokens, account IDs or secret mapping committed to public assets.
- [ ] AVENGERS change only; no SAC/Lock It In data touched.

## Project continuity after substantive changes
- [ ] Updated the relevant GitHub issue with implemented/deployed/verified state.
- [ ] Appended a dated entry to [docs/DECISION_LOG.md](../blob/main/docs/DECISION_LOG.md) or marked “no new decision”.
- [ ] Updated [docs/PROJECT_CONTINUITY.md](../blob/main/docs/PROJECT_CONTINUITY.md) if a standing user rule/current status changed.
- [ ] Updated [ROADMAP.md](../blob/main/ROADMAP.md) when order/status changed.
